CALAMITY-TRIAL_EVENT.title: Trial
CALAMITY-TRIAL_EVENT.pages.INITIAL.descr:
Old shapes stir at the edge of memory: guardians and champions from a Spire that fell long ago. One of them will lend its power to what waits at the top of this climb.

Choose which.
CALAMITY-TRIAL_EVENT.include: The boss of this act will face the [gold]{Trial}[/gold].
CALAMITY-TRIAL_EVENT.exclude: Banish the [gold]{Trial}[/gold]. The other two go to the final bosses.
CALAMITY-TRIAL_EVENT.pages.CHOSEN.descri: The shape settles over the summit. It will be waiting.
CALAMITY-TRIAL_EVENT.trials.SLIME.title: Trial of the Slime
CALAMITY-TRIAL_EVENT.trials.SLIME.descri: Split: each time the boss loses a quarter of its Max HP, a slime splits off and fights beside it.
CALAMITY-TRIAL_EVENT.pages.INITIAL.optio: Split: each time the boss loses a quarter of its Max HP, a slime splits off and fights beside it.
CALAMITY-TRIAL_EVENT.trials.GHOST.title: Trial of the Ghost
CALAMITY-TRIAL_EVENT.trials.GHOST.descri: Inferno: every 3rd turn, the boss shuffles Burns into each player's draw pile.
CALAMITY-TRIAL_EVENT.pages.INITIAL.optio: Inferno: every 3rd turn, the boss shuffles Burns into each player's draw pile.
CALAMITY-TRIAL_EVENT.trials.GUARDIAN.des: Mode Shift: after taking enough damage, the boss gains Block and Thorns for 2 turns. The threshold rises each time.
CALAMITY-TRIAL_EVENT.pages.INITIAL.optio: Mode Shift: after taking enough damage, the boss gains Block and Thorns for 2 turns. The threshold rises each time.
CALAMITY-TRIAL_EVENT.trials.CHAMPION.des: Second Wind: at half HP, the boss cleanses its debuffs and gains Strength and Plating.
CALAMITY-TRIAL_EVENT.pages.INITIAL.optio: Second Wind: at half HP, the boss cleanses its debuffs and gains Strength and Plating.
CALAMITY-TRIAL_EVENT.trials.AUTOMATON.de: Stasis: the boss has Artifact, and takes the most expensive card from each player's hand at the start and every 4 turns, until it drops to half HP.
CALAMITY-TRIAL_EVENT.pages.INITIAL.optio: Stasis: the boss has Artifact, and takes the most expensive card from each player's hand at the start and every 4 turns, until it drops to half HP.
CALAMITY-TRIAL_EVENT.trials.COLLECTOR.de: Mega Debuff: on its 3rd turn, the boss makes every player Vulnerable, Weak and Frail.
CALAMITY-TRIAL_EVENT.pages.INITIAL.optio: Mega Debuff: on its 3rd turn, the boss makes every player Vulnerable, Weak and Frail.
CALAMITY-TRIAL_EVENT.trials.SHAPES.title: Trial of the Shapes
CALAMITY-TRIAL_EVENT.trials.SHAPES.descr: Square and Circle: every 2nd turn, the boss gains Strength and shuffles Dazed into each player's draw pile.
CALAMITY-TRIAL_EVENT.pages.INITIAL.optio: Square and Circle: every 2nd turn, the boss gains Strength and shuffles Dazed into each player's draw pile.
CALAMITY-TRIAL_EVENT.trials.TIME_EATER.d: Time Warp: the boss counts every card the party plays. On the last of each count, it gains Strength and ends that player's turn.
CALAMITY-TRIAL_EVENT.pages.INITIAL.optio: Time Warp: the boss counts every card the party plays. On the last of each count, it gains Strength and ends that player's turn.
CALAMITY-TRIAL_EVENT.trials.AWAKENED.des: Rebirth: the first time the boss would die, it rises again, cleansed, and spends its next turn Stunned and Intangible.
CALAMITY-TRIAL_EVENT.pages.INITIAL.optio: Rebirth: the first time the boss would die, it rises again, cleansed, and spends its next turn Stunned and Intangible.
